title: An entrance camera: res/field/cameras/entrances/<n>.json
description: The entrance camera of transition type n, a warp's "transition" from WARP_TRANSITION_CAMERA (7) on: a file of ARCID_ENTRANCE_CAMERA (a/1/7/7), which entrance_camera.c reads to move the camera as the player goes in or comes out. tools/data/field_camera_data.py packs them in order, numbered from 007.

distance.description: The camera's distance from its target, in whole units

use_target.description: Whether the camera looks at target; otherwise at the player

frames.description: How long the camera takes to move

departure_animation.description: Whether the camera moves as the player goes in

arrival_animation.description: Whether the camera moves as the player comes out

angle.description: An angle in 65536ths of a turn

whole.description: In whole units, which the game shifts into fixed point, so 20 bits
